name: Mercenary Lay on Hands
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Lay on Hands (players/paladin/mercenary/lay_on_hands_merc.sval, 18 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): cooldown 10 s (8 s). Its own mana 75 (60), cooldown 10 s (8 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Lay on Hands with the level-4 blessing (4.5 s, 9 + 2% heal, 25% chance to block 20 magical) on a 10 s cooldown.
